name: Monopotassium Phosphate (KH2PO4)
description: The macro phosphate source for Estimative Index dosing. Disclosed stoichiometry: 0.1 g in 10 US gal (~37.85 L) raises PO4 by ~1.84 ppm (with a small K contribution).
notes: Phosphate source for high-tech planted tanks. Overdosing phosphate alone rarely harms plants but can fuel algae if light/CO2 are unbalanced.
